segments.text: Order to Audit: a GST-ready ERP for a snack factory, from the first field order to the final audit.

segments.caption: A snack factory
segments.text: Five roles share one Django application: salesman, admin, production, auditor and owner.

segments.caption: Everyone signs in
segments.text: One ledger, no spreadsheets in between, and nothing gets retyped.

segments.caption: Salesman A signs in
segments.text: Salesman A signs in. Every field order starts here.

segments.caption: Placing a
segments.text: Five thousand packets of Murukku for Retailer A in Tamil Nadu.

segments.caption: Instant stock check
segments.text: Stock is checked on submit: {{availablePackets}} on hand, {{shortagePackets}} short.

segments.caption: The field-capture PWA
segments.text: In the field there may be no signal; the PWA works offline.

segments.caption: Network dropped
segments.text: The network is gone; the app carries on.

segments.caption: Saved locally
segments.text: The order queues with an idempotency key, so a retry cannot duplicate it.

segments.caption: Back online
segments.text: Back online, the queue replays through the same API.

segments.caption: Masters: items
segments.text: Masters hold items, HSN codes, GST rates and variance tolerances.

segments.caption: Table-driven conversions
segments.text: Unit conversions are table-driven: kilograms to grams, litres to millilitres, cartons to packets.

segments.caption: Customer state
segments.text: The customer's state decides the tax: Tamil Nadu splits CGST and SGST; Karnataka uses IGST.

segments.caption: The Murukku 200 g BOM
segments.text: The Murukku bill of materials plans two hundred packets per batch, consumed line by line.

segments.caption: Admin reviews
segments.text: Admin reviews the field order against live stock.

segments.caption: Admin trims the approved
segments.text: Five thousand requested, but only a few hundred available. He approves two hundred packets.

segments.caption: Approval checks
segments.text: Approval checks stock coverage before it commits.

segments.caption: Gapless financial-year
segments.text: Gapless financial-year number; intra-state supply splits CGST and SGST.

segments.caption: The GST tax invoice
segments.text: The same document is a print-ready GST invoice.

segments.caption: Zoomed in
segments.text: At full size: HSN, quantity, rate, taxable value, and the two tax halves.

segments.caption: Dispatch posts
segments.text: Dispatch posts finished goods out of stock. Posted documents are never edited.

segments.caption: A Rs 5,000 receipt
segments.text: A five thousand rupee receipt auto-allocates FIFO to the oldest open invoice, and ageing updates at once.

segments.caption: Credit notes live here
segments.text: Credit notes reverse revenue and tax without touching the original invoice.

segments.caption: The production supervisor
segments.text: The production supervisor starts a run from the Murukku BOM.

segments.caption: One batch
segments.text: One batch plans two hundred packets.

segments.caption: Actuals entered
segments.text: He enters actual output, wastage and damaged packaging.

segments.caption: Raw material and packaging actuals
segments.text: Then actual material and packaging consumed, line by line.

segments.caption: Posted: raw stock out
segments.text: Raw stock out, finished goods in, as append-only ledger rows.

segments.caption: Cartons used
segments.text: Nine cartons against ten planned is a ten percent variance, outside tolerance, so the run is flagged.

segments.caption: Every line shows planned
segments.text: Every line shows planned versus actual, variance, tolerance and line cost.

segments.caption: The auditor works read-only
segments.text: The auditor works read-only, on the same data.

segments.caption: Run costing
segments.text: Run costing gives weighted-average cost, overhead, cost per packet and margin.

segments.caption: Sales register
segments.text: The sales register shows invoice-level taxable value and the GST split.

segments.caption: CSV export
segments.text: The CSV export is for the accountant; the app stays read-only.

segments.caption: GST summary
segments.text: The GST summary totals CGST, SGST and IGST for the period.

segments.caption: Stock ledger: every movement
segments.text: The stock ledger traces every movement to its source document and the user who posted it.

segments.caption: Outstanding and ageing
segments.text: Outstanding and ageing run from zero to thirty days through ninety plus.

segments.caption: Owner dashboard
segments.text: The owner sees today's orders, approvals, flagged runs and receivables.

segments.caption: Stock is never stored
segments.text: Stock is never stored: every balance is the ledger sum at weighted-average cost.

segments.caption: Low-stock alerts
segments.text: Low-stock alerts and flagged runs surface where the owner looks first.

segments.caption: The audit trail is append-only
segments.text: The audit trail is append-only: actor, action, before and after, timestamp.

segments.caption: Posted invoices are immutable
segments.text: Posted invoices are immutable. Corrections are credit notes, never silent edits.
One ledger. One trail. Zero gaps. Order to Audit is built with Django, Django REST Framework and ReportLab, and shipped in Docker.
